brief:
Emirati officials participated in a confidential meeting between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the U.S. Secretary of Defense at a military base in Israel, the Ma'an news agency reported. Details of the meeting's agenda and timing were not disclosed.

The presence of UAE representatives at the gathering reflects deepening security ties among the three parties, which have grown closer since the 2020 Abraham Accords.
title: UAE officials attend Netanyahu's secret meeting with US defense chief
